name: create_branch
description: Creates a development branch on a Supabase project, which can incur hourly compute and other usage charges. The user must agree to the cost before the branch is created. Unless `confirm_cost_id` is required, call this tool without it and without asking for cost confirmation in chat first. The server handles cost confirmation, or returns instructions for obtaining a confirmation ID. If it requests an ID, follow those instructions and retry with it. This will apply all migrations from the main project to a fresh branch database. Note that production data will not carry over. The branch will get its own project_id via the resulting project_ref. Use this ID to execute queries and migrations on the branch.

confirm_cost_id.description: The ID returned by `confirm_cost`. To get it, call `get_cost`, tell the user the cost, and call `confirm_cost` once they agree.

name.description: Name of the branch to create
